$comment: The recurring cost of the system, one line per thing that can bill, each with the repository file that creates it (or external:<what> for something outside the repository). Read by scripts/hold-security-review.py, which publishes it in the Annual Security Review (KSI-PIY-RIS) and fails on a line with no source, and by the CFO's quarterly budget review (scripts/_drills.py), which fails when an automated method of infrastructure/schemas/ksi-methods.json is in no line's funds or the known total exceeds the ceiling. Every figure was AI-drafted on 2026-11-06 from what the repository shows (the resources in Terraform, the domain, the services the workflows use), not from a bill: they are estimates for the operator to correct. A line whose figure is not known says 'unknown' and carries no number.

ceiling.basis: AI-drafted proposal for the operator to set: the priced lines today total about $54 a year, and CLAUDE.md flags any new recurring cost above about $2 a month; $120 a year is about double today's known total. The CFO's quarterly budget review (scripts/_drills.py) fails when the known total exceeds it.

lines.item: Four customer-managed KMS keys (at-rest, runtime signing, DNSSEC key-signing, Silk Reeling)
lines.basis: AWS's published list price of about $1 per customer-managed key per month, times four keys; request charges assumed negligible at this volume. Not checked against a bill.

lines.item: Route 53 hosted zone with DNSSEC, and its queries
lines.basis: AWS's published list price of about $0.50 per hosted zone per month; query charges assumed small. Not checked against a bill.

lines.item: CloudWatch metric alarms of the evidence watchdog
lines.basis: A few standard alarms; the free tier may cover them. Not checked against a bill.

lines.item: CloudWatch Logs: five log groups kept 365 days, and Route 53 query logging
lines.basis: Ingestion and storage depend on traffic; small at current volume.

lines.item: S3 storage and requests: the site, access-log, CloudTrail and Terraform state buckets
lines.basis: Depends on stored volume and requests; versioning and log retention grow it slowly.

lines.item: CloudFront distribution (Shield Standard included at no charge)
lines.basis: Depends on traffic; may fall within the free tier.
The first copy of management events is not charged by CloudTrail; its S3 storage is in COST-S3. LookupEvents (the audit-log review) is not charged. Not checked against a bill.

lines.item: Lambda (three functions), EventBridge schedules, API Gateway HTTP API, SQS, SNS and DynamoDB on demand with point-in-time recovery
lines.basis: Usage-priced; expected near zero at this volume, much of it inside the free tier.

lines.item: Cognito user pool for Silk Reeling
lines.basis: Priced per monthly active user; a handful of users may fall within the free tier.
Public ACM certificates are not charged. Not checked against a bill.
The registrar and its price are not in the repository.

lines.item: GitHub: public repository, Actions on standard hosted runners, code scanning
lines.basis: GitHub does not bill Actions minutes on standard hosted runners for public repositories. Not checked against a bill.

lines.item: Chaos Gremlin scratch bucket: versioned S3 bucket holding about 20 copied site objects for a monthly restore drill, expired after 7 days
lines.basis: AI-drafted from AWS published S3 Standard list prices: a few MB stored for at most 7 days a month (under $0.01 a month) and about 100 PUT, GET, DELETE and LIST requests a month (under $0.01 a month); KMS is not used (SSE-S3). Not checked against a bill.

lines.item: Quarantine responder: two IAM roles, the AWS managed deny-all policy, and SNS pages on the existing evidence-alerts topic
lines.basis: AI-drafted: IAM roles, policies and STS are not charged; a page is one SNS publish on a reportable event (the first million a month are within the free tier) and the nightly drill does not page; KMS requests for the encrypted topic are a handful a year. Not checked against a bill.
